default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1238.title: Autocorrelation regime switch
E-1238.hypothesis: When recent bar-to-bar changes are positively autocorrelated the tape is trending (follow a large bar); when negatively autocorrelated it is bouncing between quoters (fade a large bar).

E-1239.title: Rising-VWAP dip touch
E-1239.hypothesis: In a session whose VWAP is climbing, institutional buyers benchmarked to VWAP step in on a touch; a wick to VWAP that closes above it is a buy (mirror for falling VWAP).

E-1240.title: Volatility-expansion bar follow
E-1240.hypothesis: When the last few bars' range jumps relative to the recent average and the bar has a solid body, new information is being priced and the direction tends to persist a few minutes.

E-1241.title: Outsized-for-the-clock bar fade
E-1241.hypothesis: A bar whose range is several times the usual range at that time of day is often a liquidity sweep or market-order burst; liquidity providers fade it back.

E-1242.title: Single-bar jump dominance fade
E-1242.hypothesis: When one bar accounts for a large share of all the movement of the window, the move is a jump (a shock or a stop run) rather than a trend, and tends to retrace.

E-1244.title: VWAP deviation band re-entry
E-1244.hypothesis: A close back inside a band of k standard deviations around VWAP after trading outside means the stretch failed to attract follow-through; revert toward VWAP.

E-1245.title: Day-open recross follow
E-1245.hypothesis: After a day has moved clearly above (below) its open, a close back through the open invalidates the day's bias and shifts control to the other side; follow the recross.

E-1246.title: Late-session VWAP pull
E-1246.hypothesis: Late in the session, accounts executing at VWAP and position squaring pull price back toward VWAP when it is stretched beyond its usual late-day distance.

E-1247.title: Efficiency-ratio trend onset follow
E-1247.hypothesis: When net movement over a window is nearly all of the path travelled (Kaufman efficiency ratio high), the tape has one-sided flow that tends to persist for a few more minutes.
